cases.question: How many customers are there? Return a single number.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

cases.question: List the names of all genres. Return only the genre name.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT Name FROM genres LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM genres

cases.question: How many tracks are there in total? Return a single number.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracks LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracks

cases.question: List the first name and last name of customers from Brazil.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM customers WHERE Country = 'Brazil' LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM customers WHERE Country = 'Brazil'

cases.question: How many employees are there? Return a single number.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employees

cases.question: What is the longest track length in milliseconds? Return a single number.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT MAX(Milliseconds) FROM tracks LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT MAX(Milliseconds) FROM tracks

cases.question: Return the titles of the albums with ArtistId 1.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT Title FROM albums WHERE ArtistId = 1 LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT Title FROM albums WHERE ArtistId = 1

cases.question: How many invoices have a total greater than 10? Return a single number.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(InvoiceId) FROM invoices WHERE Total > 10 LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE Total > 10

cases.question: List the names of all media types. Return only the name.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT Name FROM media_types LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM media_types

cases.question: List the distinct countries where customers live. Return only the country.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Country FROM customers LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Country FROM customers

cases.question: Which countries have more than 3 customers? Return the country and the number of customers.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount FROM customers GROUP BY Country HAVING COUNT(*) > 3 LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY Country HAVING COUNT(*) > 3

cases.question: Return the titles of all albums by the artist named Iron Maiden. Return only the title.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT albums.Title FROM albums JOIN artists ON albums.ArtistId = artists.ArtistId WHERE artists.Name = 'Iron Maiden' LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT al.Title FROM albums al JOIN artists ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'Iron Maiden'

cases.question: How many tracks are in the genre Jazz? Return a single number.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracks AS T INNER JOIN genres AS G ON T.GenreId = G.GenreId WHERE G.Name = 'Jazz' LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tracks t JOIN genres g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Jazz'

cases.question: For each media type, return the media type name and the number of tracks it has.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT m.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM media_types AS m LEFT JOIN tracks AS t ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT m.Name, COUNT(*) FROM media_types m JOIN tracks t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name

cases.question: Return the first name, last name and email of the customers supported by the employee Jane Peacock.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, c.Email FROM customers AS c JOIN employees AS e ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId WHERE e.FirstName = 'Jane' AND e.LastName = 'Peacock' LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, c.Email FROM customers c JOIN employees e ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId WHERE e.FirstName = 'Jane' AND e.LastName = 'Peacock'

cases.question: What is the total amount of all invoices of customers from Germany, rounded to 2 decimals? Return a single number.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(invoices.Total), 2) FROM invoices JOIN customers ON invoices.CustomerId = customers.CustomerId WHERE customers.Country = 'Germany' LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) FROM invoices i JOIN customers c ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'Germany'

cases.question: List the names of the tracks on the album titled Let There Be Rock. Return only the track name.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT tracks.Name FROM tracks JOIN albums ON tracks.AlbumId = albums.AlbumId WHERE albums.Title = 'Let There Be Rock' LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT t.Name FROM tracks t JOIN albums a ON t.AlbumId = a.AlbumId WHERE a.Title = 'Let There Be Rock'

cases.question: How many invoices did each customer from Brazil have? Return first name, last name and the invoice count.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, COUNT(i.InvoiceId) AS InvoiceCount FROM customers AS c JOIN invoices AS i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'Brazil' GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, COUNT(*) FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId WHERE c.Country = 'Brazil' GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName

cases.question: How many tracks are in the playlist named Grunge? Return a single number.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM playlist_track AS pt JOIN playlists AS p ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId WHERE p.Name = 'Grunge' LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM playlists p JOIN playlist_track pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId WHERE p.Name = 'Grunge'

cases.question: For every employee who has a manager, return the employee's first name, last name, then the manager's first name and last name.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT e.FirstName AS EmployeeFirstName, e.LastName AS EmployeeLastName, m.FirstName AS ManagerFirstName, m.LastName AS ManagerLastName FROM employees AS e JOIN employees AS m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, m.FirstName, m.LastName FROM employees e JOIN employees m ON e.ReportsTo = m.EmployeeId

cases.question: Which country's customers spent the most in total? Return the country and the total spent, rounded to 2 decimals.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT c.Country, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS TotalSpent FROM customers AS c JOIN invoices AS i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.Country ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 1
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.Country, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.Country ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Which single customer spent the most in total? Return first name, last name and total spent, rounded to 2 decimals.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS TotalSpent FROM customers AS c JOIN invoices AS i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 1
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY SUM(i.Total) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many invoices were issued in the year 2011? Return a single number.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(InvoiceId) FROM invoices WHERE InvoiceDate LIKE '2011%' LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices WHERE strftime('%Y', InvoiceDate) = '2011'

cases.question: Which 3 artists have the most albums? Return the artist name and the number of albums.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT artists.Name, COUNT(albums.AlbumId) AS AlbumCount FROM artists JOIN albums ON artists.ArtistId = albums.ArtistId GROUP BY artists.ArtistId, artists.Name ORDER BY AlbumCount DESC LIMIT 3
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(*) FROM artists ar JOIN albums al ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: Which genre has the most tracks? Return the genre name and the number of tracks.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount FROM genres AS g JOIN tracks AS t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY TrackCount DESC LIMIT 1
cases.gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(*) FROM genres g JOIN tracks t ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many distinct tracks have been sold at least once? Return a single number.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TrackId) FROM invoice_items LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TrackId) FROM invoice_items

cases.question: Which customers have spent more than the average total spent per customer? Return first name and last name.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM customers AS c JOIN invoices AS i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName HAVING SUM(i.Total) > (SELECT AVG(CustomerTotal) FROM (SELECT SUM(Total) AS CustomerTotal FROM invoices GROUP BY CustomerId)) LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM customers c JOIN invoices i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName HAVING SUM(i.Total) > (SELECT AVG(s) FROM (SELECT SUM(Total) AS s FROM invoices GROUP BY CustomerId))

cases.question: For each support employee, return their first name, last name and the total invoice amount of their customers, rounded to 2 decimals.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) AS TotalInvoiceAmount FROM employees AS e JOIN customers AS c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId JOIN invoices AS i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, ROUND(SUM(i.Total), 2) FROM employees e JOIN customers c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId JOIN invoices i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.FirstName, e.LastName

cases.question: How many customers have spent more than 40 in total? Return a single number.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT CustomerId FROM invoices GROUP BY CustomerId HAVING SUM(Total) > 40) LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT CustomerId FROM invoices GROUP BY CustomerId HAVING SUM(Total) > 40)

cases.question: For each billing country with at least 5 invoices, return the billing country and the average invoice total, rounded to 2 decimals.
cases.agent_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) AS AverageTotal FROM invoices GROUP BY BillingCountry HAVING COUNT(InvoiceId) >= 5 LIMIT 100
cases.gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, ROUND(AVG(Total), 2) FROM invoices GROUP BY BillingCountry HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
